summary: REFRESH (prior report Aug 10, 2026) — IMPORTANT CATALYST-DATE CORRECTION: the prior report's '~Sep 30, 2026' date for the IM-3 lunar landing at Reiner Gamma no longer holds up under fresh research. Sources conflict sharply this cycle — one describes IM-3 as already launched (Jun 1, 2026) with a landing attempt 'in the second half of 2026,' while Wikipedia's mission page states a Q1 2027 launch, 'though earlier sources mentioned a 2026 target.' Given that conflict, the landing date is pushed out to a fuzzy H2 2026 window rather than the prior false-precision Sep 30 badge — this is a real methodology catch, not a minor edit. Consensus (Strong Buy) target $29.50 implies +101.8% upside from $14.62, but one source's much lower $14.38 'edged-down' figure suggests real analyst-target dispersion too. Base case (+35%) sits well above the core lane's realized 14d P75 of +6.6% — the gap reflects a multi-month horizon to the (now uncertain-dated) landing attempt, not near-term optimism bias.

catalysts.name: IM-3 Lunar Landing Attempt — Reiner Gamma
catalysts.description: Third lunar landing attempt, investigating the unexplained magnetic field at the Reiner Gamma swirl. Launch reportedly already occurred (Jun 1, 2026 per one source); the landing attempt itself is the pending binary event, but its exact date is genuinely unconfirmed and conflicts across sources this cycle (H2 2026 vs Q1 2027).

risks: IM-3's landing date is genuinely unconfirmed this cycle — sources conflict between an H2 2026 landing attempt and a Q1 2027 launch entirely; treat any specific date as low-confidence until the company clarifies
IM-1 and IM-2 both toppled onto their side shortly after touching down — a clean IM-3 landing is not assured even once the date is confirmed
ATM equity issuance keeps share count in flux — a hawkish Fed (rates just hiked to 3.75-4.00%) raises the cost of that ongoing dilution
Analyst targets show real dispersion this cycle (Strong Buy consensus $29.50 vs a separately reported 'edged down to $14.38' figure) — treat the headline upside with some caution
Stock is down -11.8% since the last report despite no negative company-specific news identified — could reflect broader space-sector rotation
